♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 SESIPHUMILE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, i-AutoCaptions ene-script yakho (**Your script**) ne-**Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, kanye ne-**Flex Studio (Beta)** elandwa kuqala bese ikubuza ngaphambi kokuthi ifakwe.

*(Faka phezu kwenguqulo yakho yamanje bese uqala kabusha i-After Effects kanye.)*

♦️ **Okusha: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Isakhiwo se-**Map desk**, ukusesha izindawo ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route nokunye), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, izitayela zamamephu zamahhala ne-**Open in Flex Maps**.
* Amathuluzi ayo engeziwe (ukuvumelanisa bukhoma, izitayela, amalebula, 3D, Finalize) manje alayisha ngempela ngaphakathi kwe-After Effects.

♦️ **Okusha ku-AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ku-cloud, isebenzisa amakhredithi e-Flex AI) iyinjini enconywayo, ekhethwe kanye kubo bonke. Khetha i-Whisper futhi ukuze wenze imibhalo engezansi mahhala kukhompyutha yakho (i-Translate To idinga i-Whisper). Uma iseva imatasa, ikukhombisa indawo yakho kulayini.
* **Your script**: imibhalo engezansi ithatha ukupela namagama e-script yakho yonke indawo lapho usho khona lawo magama.
* Okukhiphayo kwe-**Editable template**: imibhalo engezansi njengezendlalelo ze-template ongashintsha isitayela sazo ku-Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Akukho okukhethiwe futhi i-Source media ayinalutho? Ikunikeza **yonke i-composition**. Umsindo ofanayo usebenzisa kabusha umbhalo wawo.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** iyalanda, bese ibuza **Install / Not now**.
* I-app (2.0.0-beta.2): izindawo zokusebenzela **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, okhiye bamathuluzi e-After Effects, ama-clip avuleka ngokushesha, futhi i-OPEN isebenza kuma-precomp nakuma-adjustment layer.

♦️ **Kulungisiwe**
* Imiphumela yetimu ebingekho kuma-PC amaningi e-Windows ibuyile (ilula uma imiphumela yokugqwayiza ye-Windows ivaliwe).

♦️ **Indawo ongazikhethela yona yokuvikela ilayisense**
* Kubuzwa kanye kuphela, futhi ukuzikhethela: nge-**No thanks** konke kuqhubeka kusebenza. Ungakushintsha ku-**Flex Settings > Privacy**. Kugcinwa izinyanga eziyi-12, akuthengiswa neze, futhi akwabelwana ngakho ngaphandle kwalapho umthetho ukudinga khona.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 SESIPHUMILE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack ithuthela ku-AutoCaptions** nezitayela, izakhiwo, ukunyakaza nemisindo yegama ngalinye. **UN-NEST** nama-blend mode kuyasebenza ku-Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** ukucindezela kanye nje, futhi **Flex Studio (Beta)** ivula i-clip yakho ngqo kuphaneli.

*(Faka phezu kwenguqulo yakho yamanje bese uqala kabusha i-Premiere Pro kanye.)*

♦️ **Okusha: Imibhalo engezansi egqwayizayo ku-AutoCaptions**
* **Isitayela segama**: nikeza noma yiliphi igama imibala yalo, ifonti nesiphetho se-Flat, Shine noma Glow.
* **Izakhiwo zomugqa**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside kanye ne-Line.
* **Ukunyakaza kwegama ngalinye** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake nokunye) nokubuka kuqala, kanye nemisindo ye-**Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Izitayela zamagama nokunyakaza kudinga okukhiphayo kwe-**Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ku-cloud, isebenzisa amakhredithi e-Flex AI) manje iyinjini enconywayo, ekhethwe kanye kubo bonke; khetha injini ye-Whisper ukuze wenze imibhalo engezansi mahhala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
* **Your script** (imodi ye-Captions): imibhalo engezansi ithatha amagama e-script yakho lapho usho khona lawo magama.
* Uma kungakhethwanga lutho (ikhadi le-Source alinalutho), ikunikeza **yonke i-timeline**; imibhalo engezansi igcinwa eduze kwephrojekthi yakho.

♦️ **Okusha: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** ilandelela i-clip ku-app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** ibuyisela ukulandelela. Ayifakiwe? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** iyayilanda, bese ibuza **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Kushintshiwe**
* **AUTO CUT** ihlaziya i-clip ekhethiwe futhi isike ngokucindezela kanye. **Retakes** ibamba imigqa oyiqale kabusha.
* **Audio Studio** manje inamathebhu amancane ayisithupha. **Library** manje itholakala ku-Nest Saver.

♦️ **Kulungisiwe**
* **UN-NEST** ku-Premiere 26.5 (yayenqaba yonke i-nest), nama-blend mode afana ne-Screen abebuyela ku-Normal (i-Premiere ngesiNgisi).
* I-chip ebomvu ye-**AUTOSAVE 0:00**, ukubuka kuqala okumnyama kwe-Caption Stack, nemiphumela yetimu ebingekho kuma-PC amaningi e-Windows.

♦️ **Indawo ongazikhethela yona yokuvikela ilayisense**
* Kubuzwa kanye kuphela, futhi ukuzikhethela: nge-**No thanks** konke kuqhubeka kusebenza. Ungakushintsha ku-**Flex Settings > Privacy**. Kugcinwa izinyanga eziyi-12, akuthengiswa neze, futhi akwabelwana ngakho ngaphandle kwalapho umthetho ukudinga khona.
